create_attachment_registry: create an attachment registry to manage policy attachments from YAML configuration
load_attachment_registry_policies: load policy attachments from a YAML configuration list into the attachment registry
test_attachment_registry_match: test the attachment registry to find which policies match a given request context
build_attachment_registry_db_sync: build database sync for the attachment registry to persist policy attachments to Prisma
review_attachment_registry_singleton: review the attachment registry singleton accessor function for thread-safe global access
